stories.story_fr: Le flux de trésorerie opérationnel a bondi à 129 millions de dollars au premier trimestre 2026.
stories.story_en: Operating cash flow jumped to $129 million in Q1 2026.
stories.quote: Strong growth in operating cash flow ... to $129 million

stories.story_fr: Les ventes en Amérique du Nord ont augmenté de 1% grâce à l'acquisition de Leonard Valve et aux bénéfices de prix.
stories.story_en: North America segment sales rose 1% driven by the Leonard Valve acquisition and pricing benefits.
stories.quote: North America segment sales of $753.4 million increased 1% with the addition of Leonard Valve and pricing benefits

stories.story_fr: Les ventes du segment Rest of World ont chuté de 11% en raison des défis du marché des appareils ménagers en Chine.
stories.story_en: Rest of World segment sales fell 11% due to continued challenges in the consumer appliance market in China.
stories.quote: Rest of World segment sales of $200.7 million decreased 11% due to continued challenges in the consumer appliance market in China

stories.story_fr: L'orientation EPS pour l'année 2026 a été abaissée à une fourchette de 3,60 à 3,90 dollars.
stories.story_en: Full year 2026 EPS guidance was lowered to a range of $3.60 to $3.90.
stories.quote: 2026 full year EPS guidance lowered to: Diluted EPS of between $3.60 and $3.90

stories.story_fr: L'acquisition de Leonard Valve a été finalisée en janvier 2026, élargissant la plateforme de gestion de l'eau.
stories.story_en: The Leonard Valve acquisition closed in January 2026, expanding the water management platform.
stories.quote: Leonard Valve acquisition closed in January 2026 and advances a broader water management platform
